bugDetails.issue: Missing antiforgery token in OwnerCompanySelector view component
bugDetails.rootCause: Form POSTs to /Owner/SelectCompany which requires antiforgery validation, but form does not include @Html.AntiForgeryToken()
bugDetails.impact: Owner cannot switch companies using the selector - critical multi-tenancy feature broken

bugsFound.title: LocalizedString Serialization in TempData
bugsFound.description: Password reset functionality crashed with InvalidOperationException when TempData attempted to serialize LocalizedString objects from IStringLocalizer
bugsFound.rootCause: TempData's DefaultTempDataSerializer cannot serialize complex objects like LocalizedString - only supports simple types (string, int, bool, DateTime)
bugsFound.fix: Added .Value property to convert LocalizedString to plain string before assignment to TempData
bugsFound.fixedDuring: Test setup (password configuration for test users)
bugsFound.impact: Would have crashed application every time password reset validation failed

bugsFound.title: Missing Antiforgery Token in Owner Company Selector
bugsFound.description: Owner company selector form submits to /Owner/SelectCompany but does not include antiforgery token, causing HTTP 400 Bad Request
bugsFound.rootCause: The form element (line 6) does not include @Html.AntiForgeryToken(). The SelectCompanyModel page handler (Pages/Owner/SelectCompany.cshtml.cs line 29) requires antiforgery validation by default (no [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken] attribute)
bugsFound.fix: Add @Html.AntiForgeryToken() inside the <form> tag in OwnerCompanySelector/Default.cshtml
bugsFound.impact: Owner cannot switch between companies - critical multi-tenancy feature completely broken. Blocks all Owner company management workflows.
